Zaika Kitchens — Wedding & Event Catering, Hyderabad

Zaika Kitchens is a Hyderabad caterer best known for Hyderabadi biryani, haleem
during season, and rich Nizami wedding spreads. They cater both intimate
nikah ceremonies and large reception dinners.

Their Hyderabadi non-vegetarian wedding package is ₹1,500 per plate; the
vegetarian menu starts at ₹1,150 per plate. Dum biryani is prepared on-site in
traditional handis.

Contact: +91 91000 78845 · book@zaikakitchens.example
Location: Tolichowki, Hyderabad, Telangana
Rating: 4.7 / 5 (243 reviews)

What couples say:
"The dum biryani was the best part of our wedding — guests still mention it."
"Authentic Nizami flavors and very generous portions."
"On-site handi cooking was a lovely touch."

Zaika Kitchens is a strong choice for couples wanting authentic Hyderabadi
cuisine and offers a tasting for bookings above 250 guests.
